art_direction: Two adult men seen from behind walking away together down a small quiet Chinese lane at twilight: Wu Xie in his dark navy jacket a half step ahead, Pan Zi in olive-gray jacket following beside him, both carrying modest canvas bags. Their natural silhouettes are visible against a cool distant blue dusk, without depicting any expedition, weapons, injury or death. The mood is gentle, bittersweet and understated; neither character faces the camera.
visible_description: 潘子跟随吴邪远行，故事以背影暗示离别。
poster_text: 他们离开了；后来，潘子没有再回来。
source_chapter: 《盗墓笔记8》大结局第七十四章（二）
adaptation_note: 小三爷到门口叫人、出发前回望和离开路上的画面为基于用户叙述的虚构改编；潘子是否预感归期为吴邪的猜测。
